content.text: {"columns":[{"column_name":"customer_id","description":"Unique surrogate identifier for a customer account, assigned at signup.","business_term":"customer","pii":false,"sensitivity":"internal","note":null},{"column_name":"email","description":"The customer's primary email address, used for account communication and order confirmations.","business_term":"email","pii":true,"sensitivity":"confidential","note":null},{"column_name":"first_name","description":"The customer's given (first) name, as provided at signup.","business_term":null,"pii":true,"sensitivity":"confidential","note":null},{"column_name":"last_name","description":"The customer's family (last) name, as provided at signup.","business_term":null,"pii":true,"sensitivity":"confidential","note":null},{"column_name":"region","description":"The coarse geographic market this customer is associated with (e.g. EMEA, APAC, LATAM), used for regional reporting and routing.","business_term":"region","pii":false,"sensitivity":"internal","note":null},{"column_name":"signup_date","description":"The calendar date this customer's account was created.","business_term":"signup_date","pii":false,"sensitivity":"internal","note":null},{"column_name":"lifetime_value","description":"Total historical revenue attributed to this customer across all of their orders to date, in USD.","business_term":"lifetime_value","pii":false,"sensitivity":"internal","note":null}],"dataset_sensitivity":"confidential","dataset_sensitivity_note":"Contains direct personal identifiers (email, first_name, last_name); classified confidential rather than merely internal because at least one column is personal data."}
